newsitem.title: USA: Trunkline plans to expand La. gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Trunkline plans to expand La. gas pipeline.

text.p: Trunkline Gas Co said Wednesday it has filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to expand its Terrebonne natural gas pipeline system offshore Louisiana, adding 500 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of capacity.
If the $52 million project is approved, Trunkline will build, install, own and operate a compressor station adjacent to Trunkline's existing T-25 platform in Ship Shoal Block 139.
The company said it expects to complete the project in time for 1997/98 winter heating season.
The project involves a new platform with three compressor units totalling 28,950 horsepower and increased compression at the Patterson, La., station in St Mary Parish.

"The Terrebonne System expansion will allow Trunkline to offer the most flexible alternative to transport these natural gas reserves to multiple onshore markets through its existing header station in the Centerville/Patterson area," Chairman Steve Roverud said in a news release.
Trunkline is a unit of PanEnergy Corp.
